label: preparing
what: A surprise jubilee/tribute feast for the mayor in the great hall at eighteen on day 1, with 200 replacement fresh loaves, eight lanterns, and a discreet escort. The mayor was told about a community gathering and approved the escort, but was not told its surprise purpose. Baker knowingly provided confidential catering; secretary helped scheduling and escort coordination and agreed to ordinary catering discretion, but knowledge of the full jubilee purpose is not established. No evidence neighbour knowingly helped.
